name: github-repo
description: Everything that happens on the GitHub repositories you list: new issues and pull requests, comments, commits, stars, forks, reviews and releases. Read-only. A public repository needs no token.

secrets.name: token
secrets.prompt: GitHub token (press Enter to go without one)
secrets.help: A private repository needs this; for a public one it is optional but makes the reader quicker and steadier. On GitHub open Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens. Public only: choose "Public repositories (read-only)" and no permissions. Private: choose "Only select repositories" and that repository, and set Metadata, Issues, Pull requests and Contents to Read-only. Steps: extractors/github-repo/README.md.

requires.help: Create a plain text file with one repository per line, written as owner/name (for example acme/widgets), and save it there. Details: extractors/github-repo/README.md.
